decisions.reason: Working speed adjustment is independently and completely captured by the candidate's existing message-238 MODIFY; the dispensing-through-both-spouts condition adds nothing to speed-control state.
Requiring a demonstration of dispensing through both spouts does not change the required stream quality, dripping behavior, beverage preservation, or pour sequence.
Continuous operation for several minutes is already completely captured by the candidate's message-238 INTRODUCE; the dispensing acceptance condition does not further change it.
The demonstration requirement does not change the content or detail level of the wiring-plan deliverable.

The client explicitly requires repair of the observed leak and a complete demonstration showing water moving through both plumbing systems without leaks, adding a concrete acceptance condition to this Requirement.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
It’s good to hear that the machine is sturdy and its core functions are performing as expected. Thanks for the update.

Please repair the plumbing leak. Once it has been repaired, send me a complete demonstration video covering all of the following:

Both stations operating simultaneously.
Working speed adjustment.
Continuous operation for several minutes.
Water moving through both plumbing systems without any leaks.
Dispensing through both spouts.
The startup and shutdown sequence.

If everything operates correctly, please also provide a shipping date so that we can proceed to the project’s next phase.

value_updates.leak_free_operation_acceptance_condition: The complete demonstration must show water moving through both plumbing systems without any leaks.

decisions.reason: Demonstrating dispensing through both spouts does not change their required appearance, material, or fabrication method.
The source requires both spouts to dispense but does not change their barista-facing or downward orientation.
The dispensing demonstration condition does not alter any mechanical, electrical, power-system, or LED compatibility criterion.
Simultaneous operation of both stations is already completely captured by the candidate's existing message-238 MODIFY; dispensing through both spouts belongs to the dispensing-control Requirement.
The source adds dispensing and leak-free demonstration conditions but does not change cleaning access, sanitation, flushing, or liquid-trap requirements.
Demonstrating dispensing through both spouts does not change whether the spout components must be removable for cleaning.
The source does not change approved food-contact materials or their required coverage.
